Title: Generally Available – Custom domain support for self-hosted gateway configuration endpoint v2

Body.Content:
We are announcing the support of custom domain for the self-hosted gateway configuration endpoint v2. This feature will allow customers to use their own domain for the configuration endpoint used for the self-hosted gateway. 

Instead of using the typical “.azure-api.net” customers can now use their own domain for communication between the self-hosted gateway and the configuration endpoint. 

With the support for custom domain in the configuration endpoint v2, customers can also rely on services like Azure Application Gateway to expose only the configuration endpoint in the case of an internal Azure API Management deployment.  

Click here to learn more.
